title: Asia's startup funding rose 93% YoY to $27.4B in Q1, the highest quarterly total in 3+ years, with Chinese startups raising $16.5B and Indian startups $3.8B (Joanna Glasner/Crunchbase News)
summary: Joanna Glasner / Crunchbase News: Asia's startup funding rose 93% YoY to $27.4B in Q1, the highest quarterly total in 3+ years, with Chinese startups raising $16.5B and Indian startups $3.8B — Asia's startup funding swung higher in the first quarter of this year, boosted by a rebound in Chinese venture investment.
